notes: διά takes only For because the Greek expresses αἰτίαν: this is not rule 45's διὰ τοῦτο compression, so cause belongs to the expressed noun and no frame is built on the preposition.
ἕνεκεν → because of carries no lexical noun, so rule 71's frame head does not arise and the head stands on because.
περίκειμαι keeps with inside its unit and ἅλυσιν stands bare, the object being accusative (rule 106).
t015 carries the ASV's addition markup; rule 11 makes that evidence only, and προσλαλῆσαι licenses the word.
